title: _meta.json
description: Canonical contract for a skill's _meta.json (schema v2.0). This is the single source of truth: the Python (jsonschema) and TypeScript (ajv) validators both validate against THIS file. Do not redefine the field set anywhere else.

name.description: Skill identifier. Lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens; must match the skill's directory name.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the skill provides.

tags.description: Keyword tags for search and categorization.

file.description: Relative path to the sub-skill markdown file (e.g. references/<name>.md).

triggers.description: Keywords that trigger loading this sub-skill.

source.description: Provenance marker (e.g. claude-user, claude-examples, claude-public, obra/superpowers). Not enum-locked; a controlled vocabulary is a FUTURE concern.

depends_on.description: Names of skills this skill depends on (schema v2.0 dependency graph).

enhances.description: Names of skills this skill enhances (schema v2.0 dependency graph).

last_reviewed_at.description: ISO date/datetime of the last audit review, or null if never reviewed. Written by the audit system.

review_score.description: Audit review score (0-100), or null if unscored. Written by the audit system.

relevance_tier.description: Model-capability relevance tier, or null if unassigned. Written by the audit system.
